tier_should.rationale: Large-scale, nationwide field experiment with strong causal identification; novel public-versus-private social media appeals; credible mechanism tests; policy-relevant environmental governance insights. Fits general-interest outlets; minimal threats to validity; addresses spillovers and manipulation concerns.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile team, clean design, strong results, and China policy salience make top-five plausible; if not, top field journal likely. Visibility via NBER and NGO partnership increases uptake prospects.
